T1.implementation_approach: Design a user-friendly interface for browsing, searching, and filtering problems using wireframes and UI frameworks.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to handle problem creation, retrieval, and updates using a server-side framework.
T2.notes: Focus on scalability and secure data handling.

T3.implementation_approach: Set up a relational database schema to store problem details, tags, and metadata.
T3.notes: Optimize for efficient querying and indexing.

T4.implementation_approach: Design an intuitive UI for users to submit code and view submission results.
T4.notes: Include real-time feedback and error handling.

T5.implementation_approach: Develop backend logic to process code submissions, execute them securely, and return results.
T5.notes: Implement sandboxing for safe code execution.

T6.implementation_approach: Set up a database to store submission data, including user IDs, problem IDs, and results.
T6.notes: Ensure data integrity and efficient storage.

T7.implementation_approach: Create a visually appealing UI to display leaderboard rankings and statistics.
T7.notes: Allow filtering by time range and user groups.

T8.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to calculate and update leaderboard rankings based on submission data.
T8.notes: Ensure real-time updates and accurate calculations.

T9.implementation_approach: Set up a database to store leaderboard data, including scores and rankings.

T10.implementation_approach: Design a profile UI for users to view and edit their information, achievements, and activity history.
T10.notes: Include privacy settings and customization options.

T11.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage user profile data and handle updates securely.

T12.implementation_approach: Set up a database to store user profile information and activity logs.
T12.notes: Focus on secure storage and efficient retrieval.

T13.implementation_approach: Design a UI for tutorials and hints, ensuring easy navigation and readability.
T13.notes: Include multimedia support for better engagement.

T14.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage tutorial and hint content, including retrieval and updates.

T15.implementation_approach: Set up a database to store tutorial and hint content with metadata for categorization.
T15.notes: Optimize for content search and filtering.

T16.implementation_approach: Perform functional and integration testing for the problem repository features.
T16.notes: Use automated test cases for efficiency.

T17.implementation_approach: Test the code submission system for correctness, security, and performance under load.
T17.notes: Include edge cases and stress testing.

T18.implementation_approach: Validate leaderboard functionality, including ranking updates and filtering options.
T18.notes: Ensure data consistency and real-time updates.

T19.implementation_approach: Test user profile features for data accuracy, security, and usability.
T19.notes: Include tests for privacy settings and customization.

T20.implementation_approach: Test tutorials and hints for content accuracy, navigation, and multimedia functionality.

T21.implementation_approach: Deploy the platform to a cloud environment with proper CI/CD pipelines and monitoring tools.
T21.notes: Ensure scalability and secure deployment practices.
